verdict.rationale: Wise documents a multi-currency account that lets users hold, convert, and fund transfers from balances in up to 56 currencies. It adds global account details for getting paid in other currencies and balance statements in several formats, which covers holding and managing multi-currency balances from one account. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of day-to-day multi-currency balance management, and business-profile-specific docs on balance management outside the API.

support.subject: As a founder, I can hold and manage balances in multiple currencies from one account

citations.quote: The Wise multi-currency account (MCA) enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies.
Make payments and get paid in 40+ currencies.
Get paid easily in other currencies with global account details.
Statements can be retrieved in multiple formats: JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, or QIF.
